description: Returns Hyperliquid perpetual funding rates ranked from highest to most negative, annualized, with a market-wide summary (median, open-interest-weighted average, count of positive and negative markets). Markets under $1M of open interest are left out of the rankings. Use it when the user asks which markets pay the highest or most negative funding, or how funding looks across Hyperliquid.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

name: get_funding_rates
title: Funding rates
